description_en: Queries the status, processing progress, failure cause, and file download information of an export task for quota rule subject consumption details
description_zh: 查询配额规则主体消费明细导出任务的状态、处理进度、失败原因及文件下载信息
name: GetGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask

parameters.help_en: The gateway ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the gatewayId passed when the export task was created
parameters.help_zh: 网关 ID。必填，必须与创建该导出任务时传入的 gatewayId 一致
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The quota rule ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the ruleId passed when the export task was created
parameters.help_zh: 配额规则 ID。必填，必须与创建该导出任务时传入的 ruleId 一致
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The consumption subject ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the subjectId passed when the task was created. Consumers use IDs with the cs- prefix, and consumer groups use IDs with the csg- prefix
parameters.help_zh: 消费主体 ID。必填，必须与创建该任务时传入的 subjectId 一致。消费者使用 cs- 前缀的 ID，消费者组使用 csg- 前缀的 ID
parameters.name: subject_id

parameters.help_en: The export task ID. This parameter is required. Use the taskId returned by CreateGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask
parameters.help_zh: 导出任务 ID。必填，使用 CreateGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask 返回的 taskId
parameters.name: task_id

errorMessage.description_en: The error summary when the task fails, which is used to troubleshoot issues such as disabled logs, query failures, exceeded detail limits, processing timeouts, or file generation failures. This field may be omitted when no errors occur
errorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败时的错误摘要，用于排查日志未启用、查询失败、明细超限、处理超时或文件生成失败等问题。无错误时该字段可能省略

gatewayId.description_en: The gateway ID recorded when the task was created
gatewayId.description_zh: 创建任务时记录的网关 ID

processedCount.description_en: The number of detail rows written to the exported file, excluding the header. This value is used to check the processing progress. Even if this value equals totalCount, you should determine whether the file is downloadable based on status=Success
processedCount.description_zh: 已写入导出文件的明细行数，不包含表头。该值用于查看处理进度；即使等于 totalCount，也应以 status=Success 判断文件是否可下载

result.description_en: The export conditions and file results determined when the task was created. The time range, format, and metering dimension may be returned even in non-Success states. File and download information is available only after success. Fields with values of 0, false, or empty strings are omitted
result.description_zh: 任务创建时确定的导出条件及文件结果。非 Success 状态也可能返回时间范围、格式和计量维度；文件及下载信息仅在成功后可用。部分值为 0、false 或空字符串的字段会省略

downloadUrl.description_en: The temporary signed download URL of the exported file. It is returned only when status=Success and the file is not expired. It is dynamically generated for each query and is valid for 10 minutes from the generation time. If the link expires but fileExpiredAt is not reached, you can call this operation again to obtain the link. You do not need to pass the internal storage path as a request parameter
downloadUrl.description_zh: 导出文件的临时签名下载地址。仅当 status=Success 且文件未过期时返回；每次查询动态生成，有效期为生成时刻起 10 分钟。链接失效但未到 fileExpiredAt 时，可重新调用本接口获取链接。无需将内部存储路径作为请求参数
downloadUrl.title_en: 导出文件临时下载地址，文件未过期时返回，生成后10分钟有效
downloadUrl.title_zh: 导出文件临时下载地址，文件未过期时返回，生成后10分钟有效

downloadUrlExpiredAt.description_en: The expiration time of the downloadUrl returned in this response. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. It is provided only when a download link is returned and is approximately 10 minutes after the link generation time. It can be updated by querying again and cannot be used to replace fileExpiredAt
downloadUrlExpiredAt.description_zh: 本次返回的 downloadUrl 的过期时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。仅在返回下载链接时提供，约为生成链接时刻加 10 分钟；重新查询可更新，不能用它代替 fileExpiredAt

effectiveWindowStart.description_en: The start time of the actual export time range. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The actual start time is also limited by the rule creation time, rule reset, or the effective start time of clearing history records. No details are available if the start time is not earlier than the end time
effectiveWindowStart.description_zh: 实际导出时间范围起点，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。实际还受规则创建时间、规则重置或清除历史记录的生效起点限制。起点不早于终点时无明细
effectiveWindowStart.title_en: 实际查询窗口开始时间，Unix秒
effectiveWindowStart.title_zh: 实际查询窗口开始时间，Unix秒

fileExpired.description_en: Indicates whether the exported file has exceeded the server-side period for providing download links. A value of true indicates that the file has expired, downloadUrl and downloadUrlExpiredAt are not returned, and you need to create a new export task. This field may be omitted when the value is false. To determine whether the file is downloadable, check both status and downloadUrl
fileExpired.description_zh: 导出文件是否已超过服务端提供下载链接的期限。true 表示文件已过期，不返回 downloadUrl 和 downloadUrlExpiredAt，需要重新创建导出任务。false 时字段可能省略；是否可下载应同时检查 status 和 downloadUrl
fileExpired.title_en: 导出文件是否已超过服务端下载窗口
fileExpired.title_zh: 导出文件是否已超过服务端下载窗口

fileExpiredAt.description_en: The time when the file stops providing new download links. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and is usually 24 hours after the file is successfully uploaded. After this time, this operation returns fileExpired=true and no longer generates downloadUrl. The task remains in the Success state. This time is different from the downloadUrlExpiredAt of a single signed link
fileExpiredAt.description_zh: 文件停止提供新下载链接的时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒，通常为文件上传成功后 24 小时。达到该时间后，本接口返回 fileExpired=true，不再生成 downloadUrl；任务仍为 Success。此时间不同于单个签名链接的 downloadUrlExpiredAt
fileExpiredAt.title_en: 导出文件服务端下载截止时间，Unix秒
fileExpiredAt.title_zh: 导出文件服务端下载截止时间，Unix秒

fileSize.description_en: The size of the successfully generated and uploaded GZIP compressed file, in bytes. This field may be omitted when the task is not successful
fileSize.description_zh: 成功生成并上传的 GZIP 压缩文件大小，单位为字节。任务尚未成功时可能省略
fileSize.title_en: 导出文件大小，单位字节
fileSize.title_zh: 导出文件大小，单位字节

filterFailedRequests.description_en: Specifies whether to filter out requests with failed or zero usage, which is specified when the task is created. A value of true filters out records with 0 usage and retains only records with usage. This field may be omitted when the value is false
filterFailedRequests.description_zh: 任务创建时指定的用量过滤开关。true 过滤用量为 0 的记录，仅保留有用量的记录。false 时该字段可能省略
filterFailedRequests.title_en: 是否过滤失败或零用量请求
filterFailedRequests.title_zh: 是否过滤失败或零用量请求

format.description_en: The format of the exported file. The value is currently fixed as CSV_GZIP. The downloaded file is a .csv.gz file, which becomes a CSV file after decompression
format.description_zh: 导出文件格式，当前固定为 CSV_GZIP。下载得到 .csv.gz 文件，解压后为 CSV

queryWindowEnd.description_en: The end time of the request time range determined when the task was created. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and does not include this moment. If no time range is specified, this value is the task creation time and is not updated when the task is queried
queryWindowEnd.description_zh: 任务创建时确定的请求时间范围终点，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒，不包含该时刻。未指定时间范围时，此值为任务创建时刻，查询任务时不会更新
queryWindowEnd.title_en: 用户语义查询窗口结束时间，Unix秒
queryWindowEnd.title_zh: 用户语义查询窗口结束时间，Unix秒

queryWindowStart.description_en: The start time of the request time range determined when the task was created. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and includes this moment. If only one time parameter is passed, this value may be derived from the rule period. For the actual export start time, see effectiveWindowStart
queryWindowStart.description_zh: 任务创建时确定的请求时间范围起点，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒，包含该时刻。仅传一个时间参数时，此值可能由规则周期推导。实际导出起点见 effectiveWindowStart
queryWindowStart.title_en: 用户语义查询窗口开始时间，Unix秒
queryWindowStart.title_zh: 用户语义查询窗口开始时间，Unix秒

quotaDimension.description_en: The quota metering dimension determined when the task was created. token indicates token usage, and credit indicates credit usage. The CSV file outputs the corresponding columns based on this dimension. Credit usage retains decimal places
quotaDimension.description_zh: 任务创建时确定的配额计量维度。token 表示 Token 用量，credit 表示 Credit 用量。CSV 按该维度输出对应列，Credit 用量保留小数

rowCount.description_en: The number of successfully exported consumption detail rows, excluding the CSV header. This field may be omitted when the task is not successful or the export result contains 0 rows. If the task is successful but no matching details exist, the file contains only the header
rowCount.description_zh: 成功导出的消费明细行数，不包含 CSV 表头。任务尚未成功或导出结果为 0 行时，该字段可能省略。成功且无匹配明细时，文件仅包含表头
rowCount.title_en: 导出明细行数，不包含表头
rowCount.title_zh: 导出明细行数，不包含表头

ruleId.description_en: The quota rule ID recorded when the task was created
ruleId.description_zh: 创建任务时记录的配额规则 ID

status.description_en:
The current status of the task. Valid values:
Pending: The task is submitted and waiting to be processed.
Running: The task is querying details, generating files, or uploading files.
Success: The file is generated and uploaded. You still need to check whether the file is expired.
Failed: The task failed. For the cause, see errorMessage.

Tasks that are not completed within 10 minutes after creation are processed as Failed. After a file expires, the task remains in the Success state
status.description_zh:
任务当前状态。

Pending：已提交，等待处理。
Running：正在查询明细、生成文件或上传文件。
Success：文件已生成并上传。仍需检查文件是否过期。
Failed：任务失败，原因见 errorMessage。

超过创建时间 10 分钟仍未完成的任务按 Failed 处理。文件过期后，任务仍保持 Success

subjectId.description_en: The consumer or consumer group ID recorded when the task was created
subjectId.description_zh: 创建任务时记录的消费者或消费者组 ID

subjectName.description_en: The subject name recorded when the task was created, which is used to match consumption logs. Subsequent changes to the subject name do not modify the name recorded for this task
subjectName.description_zh: 创建任务时记录的主体名称，用于匹配消费日志。后续主体名称变化不会修改该任务记录的名称

taskId.description_en: The export task ID, which is the same as the taskId request parameter
taskId.description_zh: 导出任务 ID，与请求参数 taskId 一致

taskType.description_en: The task type. The value is fixed as FinOpsUsageDetailExport, which indicates the export of quota rule subject consumption details
taskType.description_zh: 任务类型，固定为 FinOpsUsageDetailExport，表示配额规则主体消费明细导出

totalCount.description_en: The total number of detail rows to be exported as counted by backend queries, excluding the CSV header. This value may be 0 before the counting is completed. You cannot determine whether the result is empty or the task is completed based solely on this value
totalCount.description_zh: 后台查询统计的待导出明细总行数，不包含 CSV 表头。完成统计前可能为 0，不能仅凭此值判断结果为空或任务已完成

requestId.description_en: The request ID of this OpenAPI query call, which is used to troubleshoot call issues. This is different from the request_id of each consumption record in the exported file
requestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 查询调用的请求 ID，用于排查调用问题。与导出文件中每条消费记录的 request_id 不同

v1_parameters.help_en: The gateway ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the gatewayId passed when the export task was created
v1_parameters.help_zh: 网关 ID。必填，必须与创建该导出任务时传入的 gatewayId 一致
v1_parameters.name: gatewayId

v1_parameters.help_en: The quota rule ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the ruleId passed when the export task was created
v1_parameters.help_zh: 配额规则 ID。必填，必须与创建该导出任务时传入的 ruleId 一致
v1_parameters.name: ruleId

v1_parameters.help_en: The consumption subject ID. This parameter is required and must be the same as the subjectId passed when the task was created. Consumers use IDs with the cs- prefix, and consumer groups use IDs with the csg- prefix
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费主体 ID。必填，必须与创建该任务时传入的 subjectId 一致。消费者使用 cs- 前缀的 ID，消费者组使用 csg- 前缀的 ID
v1_parameters.name: subjectId

v1_parameters.help_en: The export task ID. This parameter is required. Use the taskId returned by CreateGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask
v1_parameters.help_zh: 导出任务 ID。必填，使用 CreateGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask 返回的 taskId
v1_parameters.name: taskId
